title: 有损压缩文本自编码器
summary: 本文提出一种文本自编码器架构，通过沿时间轴对隐藏表示进行残差降采样与升采样，并引入残差低维离散瓶颈，学习文本的压缩潜在表示。在网页文本数据上达到2.24比特/字节的压缩率，与无损压缩算法相当，同时保持良好重建与下游任务性能。
summary_en: This work proposes an autoencoder architecture that learns compressed latent representations of text via residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. It achieves 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, on par with lossless compression, while maintaining good reconstruction and downstream task performance.
